items.name: NIT Trichy Open 2017

venue.name: [National Institute of Technology](http://www.nitt.edu/home/)
venue.address: Tanjore Main Road, National Highway 67,Tiruchirappalli - 620015, Tamil Nadu, India

items.information:
Spot registrations will not be allowed. Make sure you register over here on or before the 4th of October. 

The registration fees will be an **INR 130 base fee** with which you can participate for a maximum of **4 events** plus **INR 30 for every additional event**. The registration fee will have to be paid at the venue. 

For first timers : Please refer to the WCA regulations before attending the competition. To register, create a WCA account by signing up, confirm your account and then come back to this page and register.

items.name: Newport Fall 2017

venue.name: Harbor Day School
venue.details: The competition will take place in the Blass Gymnasium.

items.information: The competition will be held in the Blass Gymnasium. The cost of registration is a flat fee of $22.97. $1 of your registration fee will go to CubingUSA and $1 will go towards funding SoCal cubing expenses. We will **not be taking registration at the door.** See the tabs for more details.
